title: Property insurance claim payout determination
description: Determines whether and how much an insurer pays on a property damage claim. Reference logic agreed between insurer and reinsurer/regulator; drafted policy wording must implement exactly this logic.

atoms.question: Was the policy in force on the date of loss?
atoms.description: Premiums were paid up and the policy had not lapsed or been cancelled as at the date of loss.

atoms.question: Was the loss caused by an excluded peril?
atoms.description: The proximate cause of the loss is a peril excluded under the policy (flood, war, wilful act of the insured).

atoms.question: Does the loss amount exceed the deductible?
atoms.description: The assessed loss amount is greater than the policy deductible.

atoms.question: Was the claim notified within 30 days of the loss?
atoms.description: The insured gave notice of the claim to the insurer within thirty days of the date of loss.

atoms.question: Has the insured provided complete supporting documentation?
atoms.description: Proof of loss, ownership, and valuation documents have all been provided as required by the policy.

outcomes.label: Claim denied
outcomes.description: No amount is payable under the policy.

outcomes.label: Below deductible
outcomes.description: The claim is valid but no payment is due because the loss does not exceed the deductible.

outcomes.label: Full payment
outcomes.description: The insurer pays the assessed loss less the deductible.

outcomes.label: Reduced payment
outcomes.description: The insurer pays the assessed loss less the deductible, reduced by the late-notice/incomplete-documentation adjustment of 15%.
